loc-jungle.name: Location pass: Fern Jungle
loc-jungle.description: Reference mockup at 4x of the 640x360 view, drawn by art/plan/locations/make_locations.py with the real T-Rex, egg and HUD sprites. Morning jungle: canopy and vines, light shafts, a waterfall far back, fern line, dark dirt ground. Thorn bushes for small cacti, an upright log for the big one.

loc-volcano.name: Location pass: Volcano
loc-volcano.description: Reference mockup at 4x of the 640x360 view, drawn by art/plan/locations/make_locations.py with the real T-Rex, egg and HUD sprites. Dusk volcano with lava streams, basalt ridges, charcoal ground with glowing cracks, embers. Obsidian spikes with orange rims for cacti. HUD turns cream.

loc-ice.name: Location pass: Ice Age
loc-ice.description: Reference mockup at 4x of the 640x360 view, drawn by art/plan/locations/make_locations.py with the real T-Rex, egg and HUD sprites. Pale lavender sky with a mint aurora, snowy peaks, frosted pines, snow ground. Ice crystal spikes for cacti.

loc-coast.name: Location pass: Prehistoric Coast
loc-coast.description: Reference mockup at 4x of the 640x360 view, drawn by art/plan/locations/make_locations.py with the real T-Rex, egg and HUD sprites. Turquoise sea with sea stacks, an island and a plesiosaur, cycad palms, a pale shell shore with tide pools. Pink coral for small cacti, tall orange coral for the big one.

loc-swamp.name: Location pass: Glow Swamp
loc-swamp.description: Reference mockup at 4x of the 640x360 view, drawn by art/plan/locations/make_locations.py with the real T-Rex, egg and HUD sprites. Night swamp: moon, mangroves, still water, giant glowing cyan and pink mushrooms, fireflies, moss mud ground. Cattails for small cacti, a thorn vine for the big one. HUD turns cream.
